The Tropicool series continues and this time we go down underwater. Tropicool 5 comes with an enhanced set of features and the classic Cool Reel mechanics.
Tropicool 5 is a 6 columns by 5 rows slot with dropping symbols, big symbols, all win ways and a feature Cool Reel. The feature Cool Reel is up to 2 rows. The Locked Wild features and multiplier symbols remain, as do the Row Swap mechanics and Mystery symbols. Tropicool 5 also comes with a bunch of new features: the Wild Egg symbol, Golden symbols and the Mystery Crocodile feature. The Birds are back and this time they act like Wild symbols. Elmo the sloth collects pearls and when activated Elmo drops down the entire Cool Reel.
The Bonus game is triggered by 3 or more Bonus symbols to run 6 or more bonus drops.
Bet amount and balance are always displayed in the info bar at the bottom of the game view in the currency that the player has chosen. This information is always available throughout the gaming session. Winnings are displayed in the selected currency in the middle of the info bar at the bottom of the game view when playing in either portrait or landscape mode.
All win ways with 15,625 ways.
3 or more Bonus symbols trigger the Bonus game. The Player gets 9 or more bonus drops. Locked Wild features and Win Multipliers are persistent over the bonus drops for even greater chances to win.
Casino Slot 15,625 ways to win No 6 columns 5 rows __TBB__ max bet __TBB__ max bet
The Wild symbol substitutes for any paying symbol. A winning combination of only Wild symbols pays as the highest paying symbol. The Locked Wild symbol is a Wild symbol charged to last for the number of wins displayed on the symbol. It is removed after the last charge is used. The Row Swap symbol removes all payout symbols on a row and fills the row with matching payout symbols. The Mystery symbol reveals a symbol when no more wins are present. The Flamingo symbol is a Wild symbol that can occur in sizes 1x4 up to 1x5. The Toucan symbol is a Wild symbol that can occur in sizes 1x2 up to 1x3. The Elmo symbol clears all payout symbols and empty clam shells on the top 3-5 rows. This guarantees a full Cool Reel drop. The Wild Egg symbol is a sticky Wild symbol. When there is at least 1 empty symbol position in the column, it turns into a Wild bird. The golden symbol has a multiplier value attached to it. The value is determined by its position in the grid. The Mystery Crocodile feature appears in the Cool Reel and drops Mystery symbols to the game grid. 3 or more Bonus symbols trigger the Bonus game. The Extra Drops symbol adds more bonus drops when it lands during the Bonus game. The Multiplier symbol adds its displayed value to the global multiplier.

The Wild Egg symbol is a sticky Wild that turns into a Wild bird when there is space in its reel for it to expand. The Toucan and Flamingo are Wild symbols of sizes 1x2 to 1x5. They are created from the Wild Egg.
Elmo collects Pearls from clamshell symbols once no more wins are possible. There’s always a chance Elmo will drop the Pearls and clear the top rows, triggering the whole Cool Reel to drop in! Kyle the Mystery Crocodile is a 6x2 special symbol that slides into the Cool Reel and drops Mystery symbols on to the grid whenever there is space below him.
Mystery symbols reveal paying or feature symbols when all wins are resolved. The Row Swap symbol selects 1 random paying symbol on its row to replace all other symbols on the same row. The Golden Symbol has a multiplier value attached to it. The displayed value is determined by its position in the grid. Elmo collects Pearls from clamshell symbols once no more wins are possible. There’s always a chance Elmo will drop the Pearls and clear the top rows, triggering the whole Cool Reel to drop in!
Wilds symbols substitute for any paying symbol. The Locked Wild symbol is a Wild symbol charged to last for the number of wins displayed on the symbol. It is sticky until the last charge is used.
Paying symbols and Row Swap, Wild, Locked Wild, and Mystery features can drop in at 2x2 size. Big symbols pay as the amount of regular 1x1 symbols they cover. The Cool Reel drops feature symbols and empty ice cubes into the grid after wins. Ice cubes get crushed immediately to make room for more features and symbols! Then symbols drop down with gravity, and new symbols refill from the top.
3 or more Bonus symbols in the main game triggers the Bonus game. The Cool Reel also contains Extra Drop symbols and Multiplier symbols. Adds the displayed value to the global multiplier. Adds the displayed value of bonus drops to the Bonus game.
* Unique Init ****************************** Tropicool 5 is a 6 columns by 5 rows slot with dropping symbols, a 2 row feature Cool Reel and 15,625 ways to win.
* General Init ***************************** The minimum bet is __MINBADEFBMODE__, the maximum bet is __MAXBADEFBMODE__. Each bet is __CPBB__ coins. Wins begin with the first leftmost column and only pay from left to right on consecutive columns. No gaps between the columns are allowed. Only the longest payline per active payline is paid out. An active payline is defined as the longest winning symbol combination. A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the Spin button. The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin. Hold down the Spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of game rounds to be played automatically. The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin. Hold down the spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the bet level, loss limit and the number of game rounds to be played automatically. Winnings and winning combinations are paid out according to the Paytable. Winnings are presented in the player's currency or in coins. The player can change preference in Settings. Winnings are presented in the player's currency. The game is played in two modes; normal mode and bonus mode with bonus drops. The Wild symbols substitute for any paying symbol. A winning combination of only Wild symbols pays as the highest paying symbol.
* Game specific **************************** * Cool Reel, Gravity, Explosions ************
The Cool Reel on the top of the main grid comprises 2 rows with feature symbols, empty ice cubes and empty cells. Feature symbols activate when they drop down into the main grid. Ice cubes are spacers. A game round starts in Normal mode with new symbols dropping into the main grid and new feature symbols sliding in from the right in the Cool Reel. Each winning combination in the main grid is paid and the symbols, except Wild Egg symbols and Locked Wild symbols with charges remaining, are removed from the grid while the remaining symbols drop down. The feature symbols in the Cool Reel above empty cells drop down into the main grid followed by new symbols refilling the main grid.
The Cool Reel is refilled from the right, pushing all symbols to the left. Any new winning combinations are paid and this avalanche repeats until no more wins are possible. Mystery symbols activate first, followed by Row Swap symbols, Elmo feature, and Bonus trigger.
* BIG SYMBOLS ******************************* Any paying and feature symbol except Elmo, Wild Egg, Birds, Multiplier, Pearl, extra drop and bonus symbols can appear as 2x2 big symbols. A 2x2 big symbol pays out as 4 regular symbols of the same type. If an entire big symbol cannot completely drop down from the Cool Reel into the main grid, it will split into regular 1x1 symbols allowing some of them to drop down. Any empty spaces below a big symbol on the grid will be filled with 1x1 symbols of the same type as the big symbol.
* LOCKED WILDS ******************************** The Locked Wild symbol is a Wild symbol charged to last for the number of wins displayed on it. It is removed after the last charge is used. Locked Wild symbols remain in the Base game and Bonus game.
* MYSTERY SYMBOL ****************************** The Mystery symbols are revealed when there are no more wins present in a symbol drop. All Mystery symbols will reveal the same payout symbol.
* GOLDEN SYMBOL ****************************** A paying symbol may appear as a golden symbol with a win multiplier. The multiplier value is x2 when the symbol is on the top row of the grid and increases by 1 for each row below. The maximum multiplier value is x6. Multiple win multipliers in the same column are added, while multiple win multipliers in different columns are multiplied.
* ROW SWAP ************************************ The Row Swap feature symbol replaces all symbols on a row to matching payout symbols. 1 of the paying symbols on the row is selected to replace all other symbols on the same row. If the Flamingo, Toucan, Wild Egg, or Wild symbol is selected it will replace all other symbols with Wild symbols. The feature is activated at the end of the avalanche after any winnings, Mystery symbols are revealed, and Wild Egg symbols are activated. Any additional Row Swap feature symbols on the same row will extend the symbol replacement to its column. Any symbol position that would be changed to different symbols due to 2 Row Swap actions, will be replaced by a Wild symbol. If this column would intersect with any other row also replaced by a Row Swap symbol, the intersecting symbol will be replaced with a Wild symbol. A big paying symbol in a Row Swap will be completely replaced. If it is part of 2 or more separate Row Swaps that would replace with different symbols, it will instead be replaced with a Wild symbol. A big Row Swap feature symbol will replace all symbols on the covered rows to the same payout symbol. Bonus symbols and Pearl symbols in a Row Swap will be temporarily replaced for a possible winning combination, and then revert back. Wild symbols will not be replaced in a Row Swap.
* MYSTERY CROCODILE ****************************** The Mystery Crocodile symbol appears in the Cool Reel as a 6x2 symbol. Empty cells in the main grid under the Mystery Crocodile symbol fill up with Mystery symbols. The Crocodile moves to the left when no more empty symbol positions can be filled with Mystery symbols.
* WILD EGG SYMBOL ****************************** The Wild Egg symbol functions as a sticky Wild symbol. If there is at least 1 empty symbol position in its column, it activates and transforms into a toucan or flamingo. The birds act as Wild symbols which are removed when they are part of a winning combination. The size of the birds created by the Wild Egg is determined by the number of empty symbol positions in the column. The birds can assume sizes 1x2, 1x3, 1x4 or 1x5.
* ELMO FEATURE ****************************** The Elmo Sloth feature can trigger in any spin or Bonus Drop when there are no more winning combinations and Elmo collects a pearl symbol. When the Elmo feature is triggered, it will remove all payout symbols from the topmost 3, 4 or 5 rows of the game grid, and any remaining empty pearl symbols. All symbols in the Cool Reel will drop down into the game grid. Every time the Elmo collects, there is an equal chance of him triggering. The amount of collected pearls is kept for each bet level and remains between game rounds.
* BONUS ***************************************** 3 or more Bonus symbols appearing anywhere on the main grid trigger the Bonus game when there are no more wins present and all other features have been activated. • 3 Bonus symbols: 6 bonus drops • 4 Bonus symbols: 9 bonus drops • 5 Bonus symbols: 12 bonus drops • 6 Bonus symbols: 15 bonus drops In the Bonus game, the Cool Reel also contains extra drop symbols and multiplier symbols. The Extra drops symbol adds its displayed number of extra bonus drops. The Multiplier Symbol adds its displayed value to the win multiplier. These symbols will be triggered when they drop down from the Cool Reel. Extra Drops: Adds 1, 2 or 3 bonus drops. • Multiplier symbols: Adds x1, x2 or x3 to the win multiplier. • Extra Drops and Multiplier symbols cannot appear as big symbols. The Bonus game starts with a new set of symbols in the grid and new feature symbols in the Cool Reel. The Win multiplier in the Bonus game starts at x1. The Cool Reel is refilled with new feature symbols for every free drop. Locked Wild symbols in the main grid remain between bonus drops until fully used.
* General End ******************************* Winnings are paid out at the end of a game round. The maximum total win in a game round is capped at __TBB__ the placed bet. A game round is immediately ended when the win cap is reached, and the wins collected so far will be paid out. The maximum total win is accumulated across all wins in the game round and can be obtained from one big win or several smaller wins. The probability to hit the maximum total win in the game is __MWP__. No bets can be changed during a game round. The theoretical return to player (RTP) is __RTP__. In the event of malfunction all bets and wins are void. Last updated 2026-03-24
The X-iter feature offers buy-in to different game modes.
SUPER BONUS: Buy a game round triggering the Super Bonus game, with 3 Locked Wilds in each Bonus Drop. Cost is __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BUY BONUS: Buy a game round triggering the Bonus game with bonus drops. Cost is __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
LOCKED WILDS: Buy a game round with a guaranteed 3 Locked Wild symbols. Cost is __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
MEGA HUNT: Buy a game round with more than 15x chance to trigger bonus drops. Cost is __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BONUS HUNT: Buy a game round with more than 4x chance to trigger bonus drops. Cost is __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
An X-iter feature is purchased by pressing the X-iter button, selecting X-iter mode showing the cost in the player's currency, and pressing the Spin button. The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game. The theoretical payout (RTP) for all X-iter game modes are __RTP__. The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__, the maximum X-iter cost is __MAXBABMODE__. All game rules apply in X-iter mode. Last updated 2026-03-24
